import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import scale
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, f1_score
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPClassifier
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier

# NN script equivalent
NUM_TRIALS=10
table=pd.read_csv('/data/diabeticos2.csv')
y=table['Tipo'].to_numpy(); X=table.drop(columns=['Tipo','G120','I120']).to_numpy(); X=scale(X)
acc=[]
for i in range(NUM_TRIALS):
    X_train,X_test,y_train,y_test=train_test_split(X,y,stratify=y,test_size=0.20)
    nn=MLPClassifier(learning_rate_init=0.001, alpha=0.0005, hidden_layer_sizes=(50,), max_iter=10000)

# DT/RF script equivalent
X=table.drop(columns=['Tipo','G120','I120']).to_numpy(); y=table['Tipo'].to_numpy()
rf_f1=[]
for i in range(NUM_TRIALS):
    X_train,X_test,y_train,y_test=train_test_split(X,y,stratify=y,test_size=0.20)
    rf=RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=20, criterion='gini')
    rf.fit(X_train,y_train)
